tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the documentation by keywords and return the most relevant excerpts, each with its source page title and link.

query.description: A few keywords, the words the page itself would use (e.g. "webhook signature"), rather than a whole question. Search again with other words when nothing useful comes back.

version.description: A version slug from list_versions. Leave it out for the default version.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List the versions of the documentation. The default version is the one every tool uses when you name none.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List the documentation sections and API references of a version, with the slug that list_pages and list_endpoints take.

version.description: A version slug from list_versions. Leave it out for the default version.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List the pages of one documentation section, nested as its sidebar shows them, each linked by the URL read_page takes.

version.description: A version slug from list_versions. Leave it out for the default version.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read a documentation page as Markdown. Pass its URL as search or list_pages gives it, or its path on this site. For a section's pages call list_pages, and for an API reference list_endpoints and read_endpoint.

url.description: The page's URL, or its path on this site

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: List the endpoints of one API reference (method, path and summary), grouped by tag, each linked by the URL read_endpoint takes.

reference.description: The API reference's slug, from list_sections

version.description: A version slug from list_versions. Leave it out for the default version.

tools.name: read_endpoint
tools.description: Read one API endpoint as Markdown: its parameters, request body and responses, with the schemas they use. Pass its URL as list_endpoints gives it, with its #anchor.
